about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a full stack developer passionate about creating innovative and scalable solutions. Currently in my 7th semester of Information Systems, I combine academic knowledge with hands-on experience in developing modern applications.
about.paragraph2: My expertise ranges from robust backend development with Java and Node.js to modern interfaces with React and Next.js. I have strong experience in DevOps, working with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines.
about.paragraph3: I constantly seek to learn new technologies and apply best development practices to create products that make a difference.
